text.tspan: Antidepressant drug consumption per 1,000 people vs. GDP per capita
Daily intake of antidepressants per 1,000 people, calculated as the 'defined daily dose'. Gross domestic product (GDP) per
capita is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
Antidepressant drug consumption per 1,000 (daily dose per 1,000 inhabitants per day)
Data source: OECD (2022); Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World Bank (2026)
Note: GDP per capita is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Where data is unavailable, the closest value within 5 years is shown
